name: Cover Up
text: Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 3 clues on it. Forced - When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead. Forced - At the end of the game, if Cover Up still has clues on it: You suffer 1 mental trauma.
text_cn: 揭示 - 将掩盖真相放入你的威胁区域，上面放置3个线索。 强制 - 当你将要从所在地点发现1个或以上线索时：改为从掩盖真相上弃掉等量线索。 强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果掩盖真相上仍有线索：你受到1点精神创伤。
